backgroundScene: Athena stands in the Laurel Senate of Olympus — a colossal hall of living marble where divine strategy is debated. Aegis-scale mosaics cover the floor in owl and olive-branch patterns. The Mirror-Victory Hall reflects her image in its enormous polished walls. Sacred owls perch on the senate columns, their bodies the size of horses. Oracle smoke curls from the floor, forming strategic patterns. The scene communicates: she IS strategy — the senate exists because wisdom needs a seat of power.
scaleCue: The senate columns would hold up a cathedral to humans but reach only her shoulders. The senate floor could hold a football stadium.
